insights.one_liner: JBT Marel builds food-processing machines; its Dutch sites in Lichtenvoorde and Boxmeer make technology for the meat industry.

culture.text: In Lichtenvoorde it develops and delivers machines for meat processing, and says innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement are central.
It is a global group with 133 locations across 29 countries, combining equipment, software and service.

open.text: JBT Marel is not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: The company reported record orders in the second quarter of 2026.
Its US-listed parent was formed as JBT Marel and is based in Chicago.

worth_knowing.text: Several US law firms announced investigations into possible securities claims against JBT Marel in August 2026.
Its share price fell after second-quarter 2026 earnings missed expectations on margins.
